input.query: Where is encounter win dialog or panel defined?

content.text:
Here is what the repo actually contains for **“encounter win”** UI.

## 1) Exact file paths

| Role | Path |
|------|------|
| Scene node (`EncounterWonLabel`) | `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scenes\combat_root.tscn` |
| Layout / visibility / animation | `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_root.gd` |
| Theme (font + default label styling) | `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\ui\terminal_theme.tres` |
| Screen that hosts combat (full-screen `Control`, grid offset) | `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\combat_test.tscn` |

There is **no** `Window`, `AcceptDialog`, or dedicated “win panel” scene: it is a **`Label`** named **`EncounterWonLabel`** on **`CombatRoot`** (`Node2D`).

---

## 2) Nodes / properties that control look and layering

**`EncounterWonLabel` (in `combat_root.tscn`)**

- **Type:** `Label` (text `"Encounter won!"`).
- **Size / place in scene file:** `offset_*` defaults; **`theme_override_font_sizes/font_size = 42`**, outline and `font_color` / `font_outline_color` overrides; **`theme`** = `terminal_theme.tres`.
- **Runtime position & size** (script): `_layout_grid_fx_nodes()` sets `position` to just **above `GridUI`**, and **`size.x = grid_ui.size.x`** with **`label_height := 48.0`** — so the banner is only **as wide as the slot grid**, not the full viewport.
- **`fit_to_viewport()`** moves the whole **`CombatRoot`** so the **grid** is centered (using `VIEWPORT_TOP_SAFE`, `VIEWPORT_BOTTOM_SAFE`, margins); the win line still hangs off the **grid**, not the full game `Control`.

**`_show_encounter_won_banner()` / tween**

- Sets **`visible`**, **`modulate`**, **`scale`**, and animates **`position.y`**, **`scale`**, **`modulate`** in a loop — no backing panel.

**Z-order / stacking**

- Under **`CombatRoot`**, tree order ends with `RoundWinningsLabel` then **`EncounterWonLabel`**, so the win text is drawn **on top of other `CombatRoot` children**.
- In **`combat_test.tscn`**, **`CombatRoot`** is **not** the last node: **`TopCenterInfo`**, **`SpinButton`**, **`ScanlineOverlay`**, etc. are **later siblings** of the same parent `CombatTest` `Control`. For `Control` siblings, **later nodes draw on top**, so the encounter win label (inside `CombatRoot`) can sit **under** the HUD and the scanline overlay.

**Related (not encounter win, but same file / pattern)**

- **`WinningsOverlayBar`** (`ColorRect`, semi-opaque) + **`WinningsOverlayLabel`** — **round** winnings; this is the only semi-transparent “bar behind text” pattern in this scene.

**Theme file (`terminal_theme.tres`)**

- Sets default **`Label`** font size / colors; individual nodes still override as in the scene.

---

## 3) Concise recommended edits (goals: full-screen center, bigger, dim behind panel, above rest of UI)

1. **Treat it like a modal overlay**  
   Add a **full-rect** dimmer (`ColorRect` or `Panel` with `StyleBoxFlat`, e.g. black ~0.5–0.7 alpha) and optionally a **`PanelContainer`** around the title text. Parent it under **`CombatTest`** (or a **`CanvasLayer`** with `layer` higher than HUD) so it is **not clipped** to the grid and not stuck under **`ScanlineOverlay`** unless you intend that.

2. **Center on the full game view**  
   Use a parent `Control` with **`anchors_preset = FULL_RECT`** (or `anchor_right/bottom = 1`) on **`CombatTest`**, then center the panel with **`anchor_left/right = 0.5`** and negative half-width offsets, **or** position from `get_viewport().get_visible_rect()`. Avoid tying width to **`grid_ui.size.x`** if you want a true screen-centered card.

3. **Make it bigger**  
   Raise **`theme_override_font_sizes/font_size`** on the win label and increase the panel’s **`custom_minimum_size`** / offset sizes; if you keep logic in `combat_root.gd`, replace the fixed **`label_height := 48.0`** / narrow width with values derived from **viewport** or explicit minimum width.

4. **Background + separation from gameplay**  
   Mirror **`WinningsOverlayBar`**: a **semi-opaque `ColorRect` or `StyleBoxFlat`** behind the text, **`mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_STOP`** on the dimmer if you want input blocked; set **`z_index`** on the overlay branch (or **`CanvasLayer`**) **above** `CombatRoot` and **above** other HUD if the win screen should fully obscure them—or **below** HUD only for the dimmer if you want chrome visible (pick one design).

5. **Optional cleanup**  
   If the banner stays on `CombatRoot`, you still need a **viewport-sized** overlay parent somewhere up the tree; **only** moving the label without changing parent/layer will **not** fix “between panel and other content” while `ScanlineOverlay` stays the last child.

---

**Note:** Per-symbol **`play_win_popup`** in `symbol_slot.gd` is only the **small floating amount** on a cell, not the encounter-complete line.
